purpose: Compare fitting and excluded-family generalization on the complete fresh scalar pilot. This is not candidate acceptance.

data.source: Fresh scalar corpus only, after collection-authority and complete-corpus audits pass.
data.auxiliary_draw_controls: excluded from fitting; genuine no-op terminal draw fixture checks labels only
data.heldout_labels: No development selection, calibration, final, reserved-original, or historical opened holdout outcomes.
data.input_manifest: Pin all accepted corpus paths, hashes and frozen collection authority before fitting. Refuse missing or substituted games.

folds.isolation: Exclude complete families, both seats, all styles and every row. Fit preprocessing and priors only on fitting games.
folds.natural_game_pairing: Keep paired seats in the same verified scenario cluster.

targets.wdl: Undiscounted terminal loss/draw/win in learner coordinates, order [-1,0,1].
targets.margin: Recorded normalized terminal tower margin, same definition as independently validated corpus.
targets.behavior_policy: Frozen collection policy remains unchanged; all learned parameters belong to new outcome models.

phases.representative: Nearest observed decision to phase center within each reached phase; earliest row breaks ties.

weights.base: Each fitting game has equal total mass; divide equally among reached phases, uniformly among rows in each phase.
weights.wdl: Ordinary cross-entropy with base game/phase weights. No label-dependent class balancing or target class masses.
weights.margin: Normalize base fitting weights so each phase has equal aggregate mass; then preserve each game-phase mass while allocating 50 percent uniformly and 50 percent to its representative.
weights.batch_normalization: Fixed expected batch weight computed from fitting games/rows, not realized per-batch weight normalization.

draw_scope.if_zero_observed_draws: Draw learning and calibration remain inconclusive; report zero natural draw count and empirical mass without manufacturing examples or a prior.
draw_scope.wdl_output: Retain three logits even if a class is unobserved.
draw_scope.future_acceptance: All existing WDL, controlled-draw and natural draw calibration requirements remain unchanged; this pilot cannot establish draw acceptance.

public_globals_wdl.input: 18 reviewed actor public globals multiplied by availability confidence, with 18 confidence values concatenated.
public_globals_wdl.output: 3 raw logits; ordinary softmax, no outcome-dependent prior shift

tree_margin.groups: Cartesian product of own/enemy affiliation and troop/building/projectile/nonprojectile-effect kind from public features.
tree_margin.features: Per group: count, masked mean and max of each selected available feature, and 4 by 4 normalized arena occupancy counts. Empty group reductions are zero with count zero. Append 18 public globals and confidence, current 4-slot hand token IDs represented as fixed vocabulary one-hot, plus causal global differences at 1,5,20 decision lags and three lag-available flags. No integer identity-as-ordinal feature.
tree_margin.history: Strict same-game past; unavailable lags give zero differences and available flag zero.
tree_margin.target: terminal margin minus current public tower margin
tree_margin.prediction: clip(current public tower margin + learned residual, -1, 1)

entity_history_wdl_margin.entity_inputs: Token embedding times identity confidence, identity confidence, 32 public features times their confidence, 32 feature confidences, and relative dx/dy/distance plus presence bit to each current visible tower.
entity_history_wdl_margin.tower_order: Own towers then enemy towers, within each side left/princess, king, right/princess by serialized tower token and canonical position. Missing tower slot gives zero geometry and presence zero. No hidden tower entity access.
entity_history_wdl_margin.pooling: Masked mean, max and count over each own/enemy by troop/building/projectile/nonprojectile-effect group. Empty groups zero.
entity_history_wdl_margin.frame_inputs: Pooled entities plus confidence-masked 18 globals and their confidence, and four ordered hand embeddings with hand confidence.
entity_history_wdl_margin.output: Separate linear three-logit WDL and one-scalar tanh terminal margin heads.
entity_history_wdl_margin.loss: Weighted cross-entropy plus weighted absolute margin error; coefficient 1.0 for each independently normalized objective.
entity_history_wdl_margin.bptt: Full-game backpropagation; no truncation, hidden detachment, or shuffled state windows.
entity_history_wdl_margin.sequence_reset: Exactly zero hidden state at every game start, including evaluation.
entity_history_wdl_margin.padding: Padded timesteps have zero loss and cannot alter live-sequence hidden state.

training.seed_rule: Use declared seed plus fold index.
training.epoch_selection: Fixed final epoch; no excluded-family epoch selection.
training.preprocessing: No fitted normalization needed for already bounded scalar arrays; any added fitted transform requires fitting-fold-only statistics and a pre-fitting plan revision.
training.memory_check: Before fitting or inspecting pilot labels, run a synthetic maximal declared game-length/capacity batch of two with backward pass; record peak process memory and runtime. If the contract cannot fit, revise and freeze the plan before any fitting. No silent switch to truncated BPTT.
training.artifact_rule: Freeze implementation and feature/vocabulary hashes, runtime versions, plan hash and input manifest before fitting. Record parameter counts and train/evaluation source hashes.

wdl_metrics: NLL improvement over fitting-game empirical prior
evaluation.prior: Natural fitting-game empirical frequency only; numerical log floor 1e-12, no auxiliary counts.
evaluation.cluster_rule: Use audited public scenario/deal identity; paired seats and repeated identical scenarios stay together. Do not treat row count or repeated executions as independent evidence.
evaluation.calibration_fitting: None during pilot; report raw probabilities and reserve probability calibration for its declared later stage.
evaluation.model_selection: No aggregate score may conceal phase or family regressions. Report both fitting and excluded-family results; this comparison cannot promote a candidate.

acceptance.rule: Summary does not replace any existing threshold, distribution, slice, coverage or draw gate. Missing coverage remains inconclusive-reject.
acceptance.counterfactual_ranking: Only after independent public-state acceptance under a separately frozen ranking plan.
